nodes.description: General HER testing conditions for monometallic surfaces in 0.1 M KOH

electrode_preparation.value: polycrystalline disks polished with 0.05 μm alumina

nodes.source_text: The HER measurements on non-Pt surfaces were performed in a H2-saturated 0.1 M KOH solution using linear sweep voltammetry (LSV)... The polarization curves were recorded at a sweep rate of 10 mV s^-1 and a rotation rate of 2500 rpm... Fig. 1a shows the LSVs of the HER on a series of monometallic surfaces after iR-correction

nodes.characterization_summary: LSV measurements in H2-saturated 0.1 M KOH show HER overpotentials at -1 mA cm_disk^{-2} of ~ -30 mV for Pt, -150 mV for Pd, and -500 mV for Ag across monometallic surfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 1a shows the LSVs of the HER on a series of monometallic surfaces after iR-correction in 0.1 M KOH. These monometallic surfaces show different overpotentials for the HER reaching a current density of -1 mA cm_disk^{-2}, varying from -150 mV for Pd to -500 mV for Ag. However, Pt exhibits a very small overpotential of ∼ -30 mV at -1 mA cm_disk^{-2}...

nodes.characterization_summary: CV determines roughness factors: Pt (1.6), Pd (1.7), Ni (1.9), Co (2.5), Ag (1.7), Au (2.2), Cu (6.1) using H adsorption-desorption (Pt), OH desorption (Ni), oxide formation (Ag,Cu), oxide reduction (Au,Pd), capacitance (Co) in Ar-saturated 0.1 M KOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemical surface areas (ESAs) of Pt, Ni, Ag, Cu, Au and Pd were determined using CV by the H adsorption–desorption (Pt), OH desorption (Ni), oxide formation (Ag and Cu), oxide reduction (Au and Pd) and capacitance methods (Co). The measurements were made in an Ar-saturated 0.1 M KOH solution.

nodes.characterization_summary: DFT calculations show HBE values ranging from -0.80 eV (W) to 0.25 eV (Ag) with FCC sites dominant except for Fe (four-fold hollow) and W (two-fold bridge).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HBE values were calculated using the Vienna ab initio Simulation Package (VASP)... Different adsorption sites, such as atop, bridge, fcc, and hcp, were calculated, but only the values corresponding to the most stable binding site are included in Table 1.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC impedance spectroscopy measures solution resistance for iR-correction of polarization curves.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The polarization curves were corrected for solution resistance, which was measured by AC impedance (ESI†).
